items.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026
items.q: It reminds me of fellas like Joe Wilder and the long trek through all these different kinds of gigs

ctx.x: a while. I get to know people who live in places. And people are people when it comes down to it. And then we’re saying, “Oh yeah but I don’t like them because they’re like this and –” it’s crazy. I know of people in Paris where you have Iranian and Israeli making music together. Now this is an example of how we humans need to learn how to live. My production company is Tribal Disorder Productions. We’re a force against the disorder in the human tribe. I know humanity is a species, not a tribe, but I’m using…

You made it your business to know where the exits were, right? I love your description. It reminds me of fellas like Joe Wilder and the long trek through all these different kinds of gigs and developing a work ethic which is so important, and making yourself stand out so your phone rings.
Yeah, yes, yes. It’s a passion and someone who doesn’t love it shouldn’t mess with this.
